name: tag-folder-explorer
description: A tag folder based explorer for obsidian. Uses the nested tags feature of obsidian to create virtual folders, allowing individual files to exist in multiple locations, inside a single vault.

scripts.build: tsc -noEmit -skipLibCheck && node scripts/svelte-check-gate.mjs && node esbuild.config.mjs production
scripts.version: node version-bump.mjs && git add manifest.json versions.json

author: semisenioritis
